# Readshot

Readshot is a free offline screenshot and OCR app for macOS.

## Links

- [Website](https://readshot.pawanpaudel.com.np/)
- [Source](https://github.com/pawanpaudel93/readshot)
- [Releases](https://github.com/pawanpaudel93/readshot/releases)
- [Install docs](https://github.com/pawanpaudel93/readshot/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md)
- [MCP docs](https://github.com/pawanpaudel93/readshot/blob/main/docs/MCP.md)

## Install

```bash
curl -fsSL https://readshot.pawanpaudel.com.np/install.sh | bash
```
